name: Space Credit #13
description:
A single metallic coin encased in a small transparent container. When in contact with any traditional currency, the coin exhibits a corrosive effect that transforms the material into identical coins, retaining the original value but altering the form.

EFFECT: Converts other physical currency into replica coins upon contact.
ANOMALOUS PROPERTIES: The coin rapidly corrodes any traditional currency it comes into contact with, converting it into replicas of itself.
TASTE: Not applicable.
PACKAGING: A small, transparent cylindrical container holding a single metallic coin. The coin is silver in color and features intricate engravings of planets and stars. The container bears the words "Space Credit" in bold, futuristic lettering.

RESEARCHER NOTE: It's like the coin that keeps giving, but your wallet might not love the makeover.

Dispensed by SCP-261 on 2026-11-05 — edition #13 of the permanent record.
